# Dyster rekordsvit - börsen mot tionde nedgångsdagen

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-08-18  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Börsfrukost episode from 18 August 2026 covers a nine-to-ten-day run of small daily declines on the Stockholm exchange, only about 1.5% below the peak. The hosts link the weakness to a fading AI trade, worries around the Strait of Hormuz, oil above $90 and US 30-year yields above 5.3%. Company news is mostly steady: Coloplast reported in line and has an EFN buy recommendation, Mowi reported record revenue and a better supply outlook for salmon, Noba and Bahnhof posted stable quarters, and Hemnet and H&M rose after positive analyst calls from JP Morgan and Citi.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 COLO-B — Coloplast | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

EFN has a buy recommendation. Low valuation after a 30% fall. New CEO; stable in-line report.

#### Reasoning

The host says EFN (the broadcaster) has a buy recommendation. Organic growth of 6% was in line and revenue slightly beat. Margin pressure comes from currency, and the wound care write-down affects only a small part of the business. The hosts see the stock as clearly cheap after the fall, with a turnaround possible under the new CEO. Because it is a defensive name, little needs to happen for the share to recover.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margin keeps falling beyond currency effects
- if wound care problems spread
- if the new CEO's turnaround stalls

> *"Värderingen är låg. Vi har ett köpråd på aktien, och det ser ut att tuffa på ganska bra."*

---

### 🟢 MOWI — Mowi | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Record revenue and volumes above expectations. Flat supply guidance plus strong demand. Sector at about 10x EBIT, with a dividend.

#### Reasoning

Ture Wester says Mowi is 'not a bad company to own'. Supply is guided flat for the coming half-year and 2027 while global demand grew 9% by value, which should support salmon prices. Mowi sold at 4% above the market price and harvest volumes beat expectations by 6%. The sector trades at about 10x next year's operating profit and pays a dividend. The sector looks to be turning operationally after a weak first half.

#### Sell Triggers

- if salmon oversupply returns
- if salmon prices fall despite demand
- if harvest volumes disappoint

> *"Det här är nog inget jättedumt bolag att äga."*

---

### 🟠 HEM — Hemnet | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

JP Morgan double upgrade (cited analyst). Shares up about 9.5%, but competition from Booli remains unresolved.

#### Reasoning

The positive view comes from JP Morgan, not the hosts. The hosts note it is a pressured stock and that competition from Booli is the big problem, which nobody really knows how to handle. The rally is mainly driven by the upgrade.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Booli keeps taking market share
- if the upgrade-driven rally fades

> *"Det är konkurrens från Booli som är det stora problemet."*

---

### 🟠 HM-B — H&M | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Citi put it on a Catalyst Watch ahead of the report (cited analyst). Shares up 2.6%.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst view: Citi expects a positive catalyst around H&M's upcoming report. The hosts only relay it and add no view of their own.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the report disappoints

> *"efter att ha hamnat på en så kallad Catalyst Watch från amerikanska bankjätten City"*

---

### 🟠 NOBA — Noba | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Stable quarter with 21% adjusted profit growth. P/E 10 with good growth. Buybacks being evaluated. Risk of owners selling.

#### Reasoning

The hosts say the report 'looks good': 11% organic lending growth, credit losses falling for a ninth straight quarter, and buybacks under evaluation. P/E is about 10 on this year's earnings with decent growth ahead. The overhang is that Nordic Capital and Sampo are expected to sell their stakes eventually.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Nordic Capital or Sampo sell a large block
- if credit losses rise

> *"P e 10 på årets vinst, växer ganska bra kommande år."*

---
